page.overview:
Who is Barker?

Barker was an American No-Maj man who worked as an assistant to Henry Shaw Senior at Shaw Tower in New York in the 1920s.

When Langdon Shaw arrived with the Barebone family on 6 December 1926 hoping to see his father, Barker nervously told him that Shaw Snr was in a meeting with his brother, but Langdon pushed past him.
